name: Integration Permission Model and Connector Architecture
description: Design the integration permission model governing what third-party connectors can access (repositories, issues, secrets, files, network) and the connector health monitoring architecture. Covers permission scopes, consent flows, revocation, audit logging, connector lifecycle (register/enable/disable/remove), heartbeat check, rate limit tracking, and degraded-mode fallbacks.
purpose: Provide a secure, auditable permission model for every integration connector, and a health monitoring framework that detects connector degradation before it affects users.
acceptanceCriteria: Permission model specification defines scopes (repo-read, repo-write, issue-read, issue-write, secrets, network), consent UX, and scope revocation
Connector lifecycle specification covers register, enable, disable, remove and their state transitions
Health monitoring architecture defines heartbeat check, rate limit tracking, error rate thresholds, and degraded-mode fallback
Audit logging schema captures permission grants, revocations, connector health transitions, and access attempts
Connector interface specification defines the abstract connector abstraction with required methods and lifecycle hooks
